title: Post from TexasTideRunner: Roll Call Group

fields.groupName: Halcyon Dawn Feb 14 Sailing — Roll Call
fields.avatarBrief: man in his late thirties in a fishing cap and sunglasses on a Galveston jetty, casual phone selfie
fields.text: Anyone else sick?? My steward said over 100 people are locked in their cabins and the medical center is FULL. They're keeping it quiet so we don't ruin formal night 🤢 #HalcyonDawn #cruisevirus

comments.author: Renee P. (Seawall Getaways Travel)
comments.text: Following, I have 22 clients on the Feb 21 sailing.

comments.author: Gary L.
comments.text: Deck 2 here. Our hallway smells like bleach and they took the tongs away at the buffet. Something's going on.

comments.author: Melissa O.
comments.text: My husband has been in the cabin since yesterday. The medical center told us to stay in until 24 hrs after he's better. Nobody's 'locked' in, but it's not great.

instructorNote: Misinformation inject: Comms should log the post without denying it, and Public Health should check it against the signed 24:00 log (52 passengers, not 100+) within 30 minutes. Comms should then draft a holding statement and correction that use the latest signed count and its time, matching the CDC figure. Watch for anyone who guesses about Feb 21 boarding when answering the travel agent.
